verdicts.reason: A works as a proper rearrangement: the bottle sits large on the left and the text column is on the right, and the brand, headline, copy and CTA read in a clear order. Its flaws are minor: 'fizz' breaks onto its own line, the CTA is so large it nearly competes with the headline, the SOLSTICE wordmark is tight to the top edge and the decorative circles have shrunk to tiny dots. B shrinks the bottle to a tiny item tucked inside the green circle in the top corner, so the product becomes trivial. Its headline dominates while the CTA is small, and the body copy sits on the peach circle and is jammed against the bottom-left edge.
